purpose: Codex adapter workflow rehearsal, not ecological calibration or an MCM scientific approval
model: dB/dt = r B (1 - B/K) - d B
solver: RK4, default dt=0.1, compare dt=0.2 and dt=0.05 against analytic solution
analytic: a=r-d; q=r/K; B(t)=B0*exp(a*t)/(1+(q*B0/a)*expm1(a*t)); a=0 branch B0/(1+q*B0*t)

experiments.parameter_envelope: min/max across the fixed nine r,d scenarios; not a confidence interval

acceptance: finite results, explicit input hashes, analytic max absolute error below 0.001 for default dt; all claims synthetic
